Seven small green cardamom pods resting together, two split to show tiny dark seeds, one pod slightly forward. Low compact natural pile, delicate botanical macro detail, pale olive green.

Two short pieces of pale warm sandalwood and cedarwood, with one graceful curled wood shaving. Lying naturally in a low horizontal sculptural arrangement. Delicate dry grain, subtle warm beige tones. Only wood, no saw or tools.
A small graceful spray of five natural lavender stems with dusty purple buds, resting diagonally in a low horizontal arrangement, tips slightly lifted. Refined delicate scale, no ribbon or pot.

One fresh small green apple and one thin crescent slice leaning against it, pale cream flesh, short natural brown stem. Compact natural arrangement, soft realistic skin texture. Only apple, no leaves.
One small elegant green-gold pear lying slightly tilted and a small slice alongside it, with a natural slender stem. Fresh creamy flesh, delicate muted skin. Compact low arrangement.
One fresh Sicilian yellow lemon cut in half, one cut half with its face tilted toward the camera and one thin curved peel beside it. Natural textured pale yellow rind. Low compact arrangement.
One small fresh orange mandarin with a short attached leaf and two peeled mandarin segments in front. Soft muted orange peel, translucent juicy segments. Compact low arrangement.
One small fresh triangular pineapple wedge with natural rind and pale golden flesh, with a second slender wedge resting beside it. No full tall pineapple crown. A restrained compact low arrangement.
One elegant short wedge of pale cantaloupe melon with beige rind and soft orange flesh, two subtle seeds visible at one end. Low compact arrangement, delicate natural coloration, no plate.

A graceful short sprig of fresh white orange blossom with five small five-petaled flowers, pale yellow centers, two small dark green leaves. Natural delicate appearance, low horizontal arrangement with a gently lifted tip, not a large bouquet.
One small half coconut angled toward the viewer, rich fibrous brown shell and clean white flesh, one small piece of white coconut beside it. Low compact natural arrangement, no milk splash.

Three glossy dark burgundy black cherries with delicate curved brown-green stems, one cherry cut open showing deep red flesh and its pit. Compact low elegant arrangement, natural realistic skin, no water droplets.

One small half pink dragon fruit cut crosswise, lying tilted to reveal white flesh and tiny black seeds, vivid but soft natural magenta skin with short green scale tips. One slim slice next to it. Low compact elegant arrangement.

One elegant deep dusty rose pink Turkish rose bloom, resting naturally with a short curved stem and one small green leaf, two loose rose petals beside it. True rose spiral layered petals, photographic fresh texture. Compact low horizontal arrangement, not a bouquet.
